evidence.title: MemTrapBench: Benchmarking Cognitive Traps in LLM Memory Use

summary: Researchers introduced MemTrapBench, a suite of tests designed to identify and quantify cognitive traps that arise from how LLMs store and retrieve information. The benchmark highlights systematic memory pitfalls, offering a diagnostic tool to improve model robustness and guide future architecture design.
title: MemTrapBench Benchmark Uncovers Memory-Related Cognitive Traps in Large Language Models
